scenarios.name: first_contact_from_cold
scenarios.what: a station with nothing on a neighbour: first-contact format, report wanted, nothing to recommend, unanswered counts up, three silences

scenarios.name: first_three_measurements_in_full
scenarios.what: levels 30, 18, 26 count in full (the estimate follows each), the fourth and fifth by halves; the recommendation may rise at once while measures <= 3

scenarios.name: step_up_two_bursts_step_down_at_once
scenarios.what: after settling: a rise is pending, a second supporting burst takes the slower of the two, a drop steps down at once and clears the pending one

scenarios.name: step_up_takes_the_slower_of_two
scenarios.what: a rise pending, then a second burst that supports something faster than the recommendation but slower than the pending one: the slower is taken

scenarios.name: step_up_pending_then_equal_rate
scenarios.what: a pending rise followed by a burst that supports the same rate: the newer is taken

scenarios.name: failure_margin_cap_and_release
scenarios.what: decoded bursts, then failures: margin up by 0.5 only at a format no faster than the recommendation, cap set and only lowered; two decoded bursts clear it

scenarios.name: failure_before_any_recommendation
scenarios.what: the very first burst from a neighbour fails: it is measured from its opening, taken as is less 3 dB, margin raised, cap set, a report with a recommendation goes

scenarios.name: failure_margin_ceiling_and_floor
scenarios.what: twenty failures cap the margin at 12; hundreds of decoded bursts floor it at 0

scenarios.name: failed_burst_opening_ignored_or_taken
scenarios.what: after settling at 20 dB: a failed burst whose opening reads (less 3 dB) within 2 dB of the estimate or above is ignored, one more than 2 dB under replaces the estimate on its carriers and drags the rest by as much (readings 23, 22, 19, 14, 11 are ignored here; 20.5 and 12 replace)

scenarios.name: failed_burst_on_unseen_carriers
scenarios.what: a failed burst on carriers with no estimate: taken as is (less 3 dB), averaged where seen

scenarios.name: sudden_failure_moves_nothing
scenarios.what: a failed burst that quality fell part-way through: not measured, margin, cap and good count unmoved, the recommendation reported unchanged

scenarios.name: estimate_drop_replaces_rise_moves_the_rest
scenarios.what: narrow bursts on a full-band estimate: a drop over 2 dB replaces and moves the unmeasured carriers by as much; a drop under 2 dB and a rise average and the rest follow

scenarios.name: narrow_burst_extrapolation
scenarios.what: a station known only from narrow bursts: the carriers above the highest measured fall 20 dB a decade less 3 dB, from the median of the top seven (fewer when fewer carriers are known)

scenarios.name: default_footing_by_format
scenarios.what: no footing given: the payload's own (power spread over the carriers it used, plus its drive), for formats in every band, and the opening's for failed bursts via an explicit footing

scenarios.name: report_ages_rung_by_rung
scenarios.what: a report is used as it is for 30 s, then one rung slower for each whole 30 s, stopping at the sender's own estimate two rungs slow and never above the report; report wanted from 30 s

scenarios.name: report_ages_without_an_estimate
scenarios.what: a report from a neighbour the station has not heard measured: ageing stops at the first-contact format

scenarios.name: one_kilohertz_band_bottom_rungs
scenarios.what: the 1 kHz band's lowest rungs are slower than the most robust format: slower() keeps its own band's bottom rung; through the cap, ageing and the silences

scenarios.name: silences_one_two_three
scenarios.what: after one silence the table's format stands, after two it goes two rungs slower, after three the first-contact format; a report with a recommendation clears them, a prelude with none does not

scenarios.name: prelude_without_recommendation_keeps_silences
scenarios.what: a decoded burst to this station whose prelude gives no recommendation resets unanswered and keeps the silences; one to another station or everyone is not read for a report

scenarios.name: report_wanted_from_two_unanswered_bursts
scenarios.what: two bursts sent with nothing heard asks for a report even with a fresh one; any burst heard from them, or a report, clears the count

scenarios.name: lone_report_on_a_drop_failure_and_never
scenarios.what: the report to send by itself: on a failed burst addressed here, on a drop below what the sender was told, never when merely risen, nor for a burst to someone else or everyone

scenarios.name: lone_report_drop_when_told_nothing
scenarios.what: a drop with nothing yet told, and a drop from a first measurement: nothing to send

scenarios.name: forgotten_after_ten_minutes
scenarios.what: what is held about a neighbour is dropped when they have gone unheard for more than 600 s, whichever call next looks (choose, heard_data, heard_report); exactly 600 s keeps it; the calls with no clock never drop

scenarios.name: forgotten_both_roles_together
scenarios.what: the sender's half (the report, silences, unanswered) goes with the receiver's half, from either direction; the other station's record is separate

scenarios.name: not_measured_for_30s_measured_as_new
scenarios.what: after 30 s without a measurement the next three count in full and may raise the recommendation at once; exactly 30 s does not count as stale

scenarios.name: bursts_to_everyone_and_to_others
scenarios.what: bursts addressed to everyone (0) or to another station are measured and move the margin and cap, and never produce a report

scenarios.name: capability_word
scenarios.what: the capability word of a neighbour is kept from a decoded burst only

scenarios.name: two_stations_exchange
scenarios.what: two Station objects exchanging made-up bursts and reports on a path that is good, falls, fails, comes back

scenarios.name: twostations_sim
scenarios.what: the calls experiments/twostations_sim.py makes: four stations (two paths, each a pair), real burst captures and their measured profiles
